requirements_summary: Primary workload: low-latency reranking and short-chat (16-128 tokens). Targets: sustained throughput guarantee and concurrency caps for peak routing. Customer asks for a minimum guaranteed delivery of 10,000 tokens/sec sustained per dedicated pool at concurrency up to 200 sessions, with an allowed burst policy of up to 50,000 tokens/sec for 30s for critical alerting. Latency SLO: P95 < 200ms for 1-32 token responses and P99 < 400ms under guaranteed throughput. Wants automatic fallback policy to smaller model variant if pool degraded. Also requires prefix K/V caching and per-customer model pinning. Network: VPC peering, private control plane, and dedicated KMS integration.
negotiation_notes: Customer insists on 'tokens/sec floor' in SLA. Redwood stance: can commit to 10k tokens/sec sustained on a 4xA100 pool with concurrency cap 200 and documented contention fallback. We proposed burst window 60s with throttled grace but customer wants 30s at higher burst. Legal: SLA remedies to be credits not termination. Pricing ask: 12 month reserved capacity + 10% performance buffer uplift. SE recommends 8% discount if accept 12-month commit and 2-week blackout-free peering window.
technical_notes: Bench results: 9.5k sustained tokens/sec on rtxA100-equivalent with 128-token avg; P95=220ms during sustained run.
Optimization opportunities: enable larger batching and KV cache to hit 11-12k sustained; quantify memory footprint per model variant.
Suggested config: reserved pool = 4xA100, autoscale burst headroom = 1 additional GPU for 60s, concurrency limiter at 220 to avoid degradation.
